title: 第23章 我最不怕老赖第24章 种灵药说道很多
slug: 太古神墟第1974章药园小酌
content_zh:
牛魔王和花青衣还没有沟通，不知道许了落尘什么好处，不能直接回答。
秘境的事三言两语也说不清楚。
犹豫片刻道：
“这事情不用那么着急吧，还需要点时间研究研究……”
落尘见状不高兴了，小眼睛瞪了起来：
“老黄，你想赖账？嗯，我最不怕老赖。”
一边说，菜刀一边在手中上下翻腾，像耍杂技似的。
“好处肯定有，一定不能少，我可以保证。
秘境那里有未知的存在，非常可怕，进不去。”
牛魔王不想惹恼凶神般的落尘，尽量放低姿态。
“未知存在非常可怕？能不能领我去看看？”
落尘来了兴趣。
“现在……现在不行……我要闭关疗伤……”
牛魔王含糊其辞，样子确实也很虚弱。
“噢，伤好了带我去。
我也不趁人之危，给我的好处，给你们半个月时间商量。
但是，现在必须先付点利息。
第一，我需要各种功法，各种武技，其他的什么炼丹、画符、炼器的也要，等级不限。
人族的功法你们也没大用，这个不难吧。
第二，我需要一头坐骑，至少花喜鹊那个级别的，能飞的，最好能隐藏自身气息。

第三，把十只魔兽的尸体运到灵溪谷。
老黄，这点利息没问题吧。”
落尘这三点要求当然是有的放矢。
发现自己是天才，可以闻一知十、闻一知百，必须要多看书。
现在他还不能飞，坐骑很需要。
至于魔兽的尸体是给小白的，小白多次暗示，唾液都流出来了。
“第一点和第三点没有问题，至于坐骑……”
牛魔王犹犹豫豫。
第一点和第三点好办。
妖兽手中有不少从人族那里抢来的各种功法秘籍，本身又不需要，况且不分等级，送落尘没什么问题。
魔兽尸体虽然对妖兽也有用，但送出去也不算大损失。
关键第二点很难办，妖兽本身桀骜不驯，四级妖兽相当于修士金丹期了，岂肯给一个人族小孩当坐骑。
强硬指派一个恐怕会引起不快。
content_en:
Niu Demon King and Hua Qingyi haven't communicated yet, and they don't know the benefits of promising Luochen, so they can't answer directly.
The matter of the secret realm cannot be explained clearly in a few words.
He hesitated for a moment and said:
"Don't be so anxious about this matter. You still need some time to study it..."
Luochen was unhappy when he saw this, and his little eyes widened:
"Lao Huang, you want to default on your debt? Well, I'm not afraid of defaulters."
As he spoke, the kitchen knife flipped up and down in his hand, as if performing acrobatics.
“There are definitely benefits, and there must be no less, I can guarantee that.
There are unknown existences in the secret realm, which are very scary and cannot be entered. "
The Bull Demon King didn't want to offend the ferocious Luochen, so he tried to keep his posture as low as possible.
"The unknown existence is very scary? Can you take me to see it?"
Luochen became interested.
"Now...not now...I want to retreat to heal..."
The Bull Demon King was vague and looked really weak.
"Oh, take me there when you're hurt.
I won't take advantage of others' danger and give you half a month to discuss it.
However, now some interest must be paid first.
First, I need all kinds of exercises, all kinds of martial arts, and other alchemy, talisman drawing, and weapon refining, no matter the level.
You don’t have much use for the human race’s techniques. This shouldn’t be difficult, right?
Secondly, I need a mount, at least the level of a magpie, something that can fly, and preferably one that can hide its own aura.
Third, transport the bodies of ten monsters to Lingxi Valley.
Lao Huang, this interest is no problem, right? "
Luo Chen’s three requirements are certainly targeted.
If you find that you are a genius, you can know ten things by hearing them, and you can know a hundred by hearing them. You must read more books.
He can't fly yet and needs a mount.
As for the corpse of the World of Warcraft being given to Xiaobai, Xiaobai hinted at it many times and his saliva flowed out.
"The first and third points are no problem. As for the mount..."
The Bull Demon King hesitated.
The first and third points are easy to handle.
The monster beasts have many secrets of various techniques stolen from the human race, but they don't need them themselves. Besides, they are not classified into levels, so there is no problem in sending them to Luochen.
Although the corpses of monsters are also useful to monsters, it is not a big loss if they are given away.
The second key point is difficult to deal with. The monster itself is unruly and unruly. The fourth-level monster is equivalent to the golden elixir stage of a monk. How can it be willing to be a mount for a human child.
Forcibly appointing one might cause displeasure.
